The employees were completely scamming customers.
Oct 2025 • Couples
在這間餐廳裏吃了一份牛肉425000 我原本點的是最普通的然後服務生推介我最貴的肉眼970000但我說不用了 點最普通可以 八成熟 但最後埋單的時候 卻給我點了最貴970000然後要我們結帳 超級生氣，叫那個人來理論 他一致說我們要點我們已經說了很多次不要他還要堅持 超級生氣我們埋單的時候跟那個經理理論那個經理也幫他們的同事 所以奉勸大家不要來這間餐廳 因為員工操守極度有問題，根本就是詐騙客人 點普通，但給你最貴，然後最後叫你結帳 真的很生氣，超級過分！

I had a steak in this restaurant today. I originally ordered the most ordinary one,425000 ，and the waiter recommended the most expensive rib-eye.970000 But I said no, the most ordinary one would be fine, medium-rare. But when it came time to pay the bill, they ordered the most expensive one for me, and then asked us to pay the bill. I was so angry that I called the guy to argue with him. He insisted that we had told him many times not to order it, but he still insisted. I was so angry that we argued with the manager when we were paying the bill, and the manager also helped their colleagues. So I advise everyone not to come to this restaurant because the staff ethics are extremely problematic, they are basically defrauding customers. They order ordinary, but give you the most expensive one, and then ask you to pay the bill. I was really angry, it was too much!

Disappointment from start to finish.
Dec 2024 • Couples
This place looks lovely and is well situated, so we stopped in for some dinner. 
We wanted to order a salad and tuna roll but were told they had run out of both. 
We ordered a pizza and another salad.
For the price, the size of this salad was a disgrace! After more than another 20 minutes, with a pretty empty restaurant, I enquired when the pizza was coming, and was told two minutes, but 5 minutes later, another woman came asking what pizza we had ordered. Clearly, they had not even begun making it, and we left. 
Their prices are astronomical and service non-existent. 
There are lots of other places to go. Don't go here!
